BrochureContent.Content:
Quillsen is pleased to present this excellent investment opportunity to the market.

No. 47 is a substantial two-storey over garden level period property, currently configured to provide 7 self-contained units. In need of renovation and modernisation, the property offers significant scope to drive capital appreciation and maximise rental yield. 

With its generous footprint and prime address, No. 47 presents multiple investment strategies from refurbishment and continued multi-unit income generation to full reconfiguration into a single high-value residence.

Importantly, beyond its strong investment appeal, the property also offers a rare opportunity to create a stunning contemporary family home. Retaining an attractive period character, with original fireplaces, exquisite plasterwork, and fine joinery, it provides the perfect canvas to blend modern living with the charm and elegance of a bygone era.

The location is second to none. Dun Laoghaire remains one of South County Dublin`s most desirable areas, with Clarinda Park just moments from the seafront, Dun Laoghaire Pier, and the ever-popular People`s Park with its weekly Farmers Market. The town centre, a short stroll away, offers an excellent range of restaurants, cafés, shops, and marine leisure facilities.

Glasthule village, Sandycove beach, and the renowned Forty Foot are all within easy walking distance. The area benefits from superb transport links, including nearby DART and bus services, with Dublin City Centre approximately 25 minutes by car and convenient access to the N11 and M50. A range of highly regarded primary and secondary schools are close by, along with UCD.
